records.source_statement: Square aspect between principal lords with reception is said to complete with difficulty.
limitations: Not an opposition unless same source says.

records.source_statement: Lilly expressly says against the ancients that seventh lord in first showed querent loves most, first lord in seventh showed sought person loves more.
limitations: Conflicts with earlier p305 interpretation; keep both with provenance.

records.source_statement: A third planet translating influence via favourable aspect between unconnected signifiers may help effect marriage.
Sun/Mars and diurnal/male vs feminine/nocturnal categories are used for alleged mediator identity.
Lilly says to test whether the mediating planet is retrograde, combust, unfortunate, cadent or in hard adverse aspect.
limitations: Even when a mediator exists, its condition is an additional gate.
